freshnessRule: Observed SHAs are snapshots, not authorization. Re-read live candidate/base, comments, reviews and checks before claiming files, consuming evidence, merging or publishing.

execution.rule: Do not repurpose unrelated tasks or infer executing agents from lane names. Preserve all existing task schedules and enablement.

wip.rule: One mutable integration candidate. Existing producer retains product files until explicit per-file handoff; at most one isolated downstream candidate within cap. Do not overwrite the current producer.

supersedes.scope: Old clone-first, clock/jobs, deferred-ABVM and ten-active-worker directions are historical, not current blockers.

inputs.rule: Retrieve the real attachment through Files and verify hash. Adapt useful components into PR301; never map a second controller, profile writer or question authority.

contract.streakRule: Cap each ladder at its last value; opposite result resets the other streak. Persist atomically; duplicate saved choices/tokens cannot double-charge, pay or count. Immediate practice-only repeats cannot farm bonuses. No debt, loss of possessions or movement/learning lockout.
contract.privacy: Roblox account identities only; no school roster, child real name, email or worksheet photograph.

lanes.deliverable: Maintain one queue, live-head handoffs, file claims and factual execution status.
Verify/adapt expanded ABVM bank and six-subject coverage; provide entry/exit/retry cases without leaking keys or importing private data.
Reconcile one tuning and catalog; integrate saved streaks, deductions, independent boards, replay safety and save/mirror failure behavior.
Compact school/neighborhood, six accessible rooms, three board mounts, exclusive plots and visible home tiers; preserve free movement and remove jobs/clock.
One readable phone HUD and streak/transaction feedback, actual previews/equip, reliable driving/dismount and touch-safe close/back.
Read-only exact-head review, independent save/replay/two-player tests and actual Roblox/iPhone evidence with explicit limits.
Sole integration/merge/publish operator. Wire reviewed lane changes, migrate conflicting AGENTS wording, validate exact built inventory and release only the reviewed project/artifact.

claims.rule: Lane paths define responsibility, not permission for concurrent writes. Record executor and exact non-overlapping files on issue302 before transfer; otherwise submit a patch to the current producer.

priorityQueue.deliverable: Reconcile 10/6 and +2/-2 package tuning against PR301's 25/15 and +5/-5; one versioned contract, matching prices/tests/UI, no save reset.
Verify and adapt six-subject/338-question package against current four-room/51-question snapshot; report actual accepted count and provenance.
Prepare six room and three lobby-board placements plus exclusive plot/home visual checks; wire subject registry after N02.
Prepare iPhone geometry and visual fixes; consume N01 transaction/streak contract before final wiring; never reskin a second HUD.
Assemble one candidate with one server/client/profile authority and run relevant complete build/functional gates.
Inspect final exact source, independent tests and real startup/phone/save-rejoin evidence; separate static, runtime, visual and physical-device verdicts.
Normal protected merge and user-authorized exact-artifact private deployment only; verify Roblox response/version and preserve rollback. No stale 33a5a11 or rescue publisher.

acceptanceJourney: correct and wrong answers persist streak effects once
preview buy and use real item
rejoin with wallet stats and possessions intact

evidence.rule: A role, plan, package, test pass, merge or upload alone never means this journey works. Observe the actual same-build behavior.
